observed.action: The character stands in place and slowly rotates a full 360 degrees, turning from facing forward to the side, then to the back, and finally back to the front.
observed.camera: A medium full-body shot at eye level, with the camera orbiting around the character to follow his rotation.
observed.clothing: A dark grey military-style uniform with a high collar, gold buttons, a gold belt, and white stripes down the sides of the trousers, paired with black shoes and a pink beret.
observed.hairstyle: Short hair, mostly covered by a cap.
observed.identity: A 3D-rendered male character with a slim build, light skin, and a short dark beard.
observed.scene: An outdoor courtyard with cracked stone paving, surrounded by tan stone buildings, wooden crates, and a red bench in the background.
